{{Top|leg|notoc=1}}
The '''Imperial Bureau of Stellar Charts and Surveys''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] government entity. This organization's [[Alpha Team/Legends|Alpha Teams]] and [[Beta Mission]]s facilitated the navigational mapping and scientific exploration of space. It provided its employees with access to the most advanced equipment available in order to further its goals.<ref name="Alpha">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe]]''</ref>
